race.comment: FONN POWER (1) turned things around last start and scored by 1.5 lengths as favourite over 1600m at Murtoa. Tail will be up after that and draws well, so no reason he can't strike again. IDLING BEHIND (5) broke the maiden last start, which jumping from 1500m to 2000m. Stays at that trip now, draws well and can only be better for the last start effort, so should go on with it. EIGHT UNDER (3) turned in a decent effort last start to finish third over 2200m at Ballarat Synthetic. Nicely placed to find winning ways. MISS TROMBARI (6) got the maiden out the way last start, which was here, so she might have a liking for this track. Jumps quickly in trip, but will have come on fitness wise. INTUITU (4) is experiencing a long win drought, extended last start when sixth over 2400m at Swan Hill. Finds an easier assignment and can play a role in the finish.
